problem_type: Hand-written allowlist silently diverges from the catalog it guards
symptom: Choosing APIMart Seedance 2.5 text-to-video on the canvas shows no approximate price beside the send button, while Seedance 2.0 shows one.
direct_cause: priceQueryFromRequest returned null for any request-body key outside the hand-written PRICE_FIELDS set (vendorPriceRequest.ts); the 2.5 body carries output_format, return_last_frame and nsfw_check, none of which were in it.
class_root: The allowlist is maintained by hand next to, not derived from, the catalog. Adding a body key to a catalog mapping makes the price silently disappear, and nothing forces anyone to decide whether the new key changes the price.
migration: The single PRICE_FIELDS set is replaced in the same commit by four named, documented sets (query keys, ignored keys, per-model ignored keys, known-unquotable keys) plus classifyPriceKey. No old name remains.
affected_population: Creators sending APIMart Seedance 2.5 text-to-video from a canvas node (no price beside the send button)
Any future APIMart catalog mapping that adds a body key
entry_points: electron/ai/onboarding/onboardingIpc.ts:45 priceQueryFromRequest (the only caller; renderer reaches it through useNodePricePreview)
invariants: A body key reaches a price quote only if it is a query key or has been checked against the model's own billing text as not changing the price.
A key nobody classified makes the quote null (never a wrong price).
Every body key of every built-in APIMart text-to-image / text-to-video mapping is classified, or CI fails naming the model and key.

door_reduction.why_not: onboardingIpc is the one caller of priceQueryFromRequest; classifyPriceKey is the new single key gate inside it. They are one call chain, not two parallel entries, so there is nothing to merge.

residual_risks: Per-model ignore entries rest on the APIMart billing text read on 2026-11-26; a silent upstream billing change is caught only by the existing doc radar, not here.
Other models carrying output_format / nsfw_check (Seedream 5, flux-3-image-klein, kling-v4-flash, MiniMax-H3-Max) stay unquoted until their billing pages are read.

external_sources.purpose: Billing section: billed by seconds x resolution tier; nsfw_check moderation not billed; output_format and return_last_frame are not billing factors.
Billing is by actual pixels and the page is unclear on nsfw_check cost, so those keys are not allowed globally.

recurrence.reason: Any catalog edit that adds a request-body key to a mapping can silently remove that model's price; Seedance 2.5, Seedream 5, flux klein, kling-v4-flash and MiniMax-H3-Max were all already in that state.
same_class_scan: electron/ai/onboarding/vendorPriceRequest.ts:68 the only key gate in the price projection
electron/catalog/referenceKeyProjectionCensus.test.ts the existing census pattern reused here

generality_proof: classifyPriceKey is the single gate and the census walks every built-in APIMart text-to-image and text-to-video mapping, so a new key in any model fails CI until someone classifies it, and an unclassified key at runtime yields no quote instead of a wrong one.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Decide per body key whether it feeds the quote, is checked as not changing the price for this model, is known but unquotable, or is unclassified (refuse).

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Its key filter now calls classifyPriceKey; 2.5 quotes, unclassified or price-changing keys refuse.
It only forwards to priceQueryFromRequest (door-map: one caller) and adds no key filter of its own.

prevention.invariant: Every body key of a built-in APIMart text-to-image / text-to-video mapping is classified for price quotes.
prevention.failure_mode: vendorPriceKeyCensus.test.ts goes red in CI listing model, task kind and key.
prevention.strategy: Split the allowlist into named classes with documented meaning and census the catalog against it.

legacy_paths.rationale: The single PRICE_FIELDS set was replaced in the same commit; no old name remains.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency is added, upgraded or retained.
